mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, user_password AS userPw, user_name AS userName, user_birth_date AS userBirthDate, user_email AS userEmail, user_gender AS userGender, user_grade AS userGrade, user_residence_area AS userResidenceArea FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_status = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( user_id, user_password, user_name, user_birth_date, user_email, user_gender, user_status, user_grade, user_residence_area ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userName}, #{userBirthDate}, #{userEmail}, #{userGender}, TRUE, #{userGender}, #{userResidenceArea} )
